component.name: AgentCenter
component.summary: See what each AI coding session costs your machine

description.p: AgentCenter is a resource monitor for AI coding sessions. Each Claude Code, Codex, pi or other coding agent session is one row, with every process it started counted in it.

ul.li: Disk reads and writes per second
I/O stall, and a flag when the session is waiting on disk
Context use, herdr workspace and pane, and working directory, when the agent reports them

description.p: A header shows the whole machine: CPU, memory, swap, and memory and I/O pressure. Every column sorts. AgentCenter only reads; it never asks for root.
